hero.title: Demon Slayer
hero.subtitle: League
hero.lead: We are the clan holding sector 770. War every Friday, clan help around the clock, and a seat for anyone who shows up when it counts.

about.title: An active clan, not a list of names
about.text: We have been here since the server opened. We do not ask you to be the strongest, we ask you to show up. Join, help, and be there on Friday, and you have a seat for the long run.

requirements.note: Below that we take you in as a recruit on trial.
A guideline only, consistency matters more.
War voice chat runs in Spanish.
That is where attacks and shifts get coordinated.

rules.title: The eight clan rules
rules.text: Short, clear, and no fine print. Breaking one gets you a warning, breaking the sixth does not.

items.title: Daily activity
items.text: Log in at least once a day. If you will be away more than three days, say so on Discord and we hold your seat. Seven days of silence and the seat opens up.

items.title: Always hit clan help
items.text: Tap help every time you log in. Five seconds that save everyone hours of building, and it is what separates a good clan from an average one.

items.title: Friday war is mandatory
items.text: Spend your attacks before the window closes. If you cannot log in that day, say so in advance in the war channel and an officer covers your turn.

items.title: Respect, inside and out
items.text: No insults, no racism, no disrespect, not in game chat, not on Discord, not in private. We do not argue here, we remove people.

items.title: Chat languages
items.text: Spanish and English in general chat. If someone writes in another language, translate it before replying, do not ignore them.

items.title: No cheats, no shared accounts
items.text: Third party software, bots, or handing your account to someone else. Immediate removal, no appeal. It is the one thing that can take the whole clan down.

items.title: The clan bank is for war
items.text: Shared resources are kept for server events. Before spending from the common pool, ask an officer in the right channel.

items.title: Recruiting is an officer job
items.text: If you know someone who fits, pass them to an officer and they decide. Nobody invites on their own, that is how we keep rival scouts out during war week.

command.title: Who decides what
command.text: If you have a question, go up one step. If you have a problem with someone, message an officer directly, never general chat.

ranks.title: Leader
ranks.note: Final call on alliances, removals, and war strategy.

ranks.title: Co leaders
ranks.note: Run the war when the leader is away, and manage the clan bank.

ranks.title: Officers
ranks.note: Recruit, settle disputes, and assign siege targets.

ranks.title: Veterans
members: Over six months in the clan
ranks.note: Access to the strategy channel and a vote on server alliances.

ranks.title: Members
ranks.note: Full clan, shop, and rally rights.

ranks.title: Recruits
ranks.note: Trial period. We look at activity and turnout, not power.

schedule.title: Operations calendar
schedule.text: Times are Spanish mainland. In Latin America subtract six hours for Mexico, and five for Colombia and Peru.

board.title: Latest announcements
board.text: Anything important goes up here and on Discord at the same time. If it is not in both places, it is not official.

posts.title: War against [VRX] won
posts.text: We closed round 34 with 28 wins. Credit to the ones who logged in at dawn to finish the last outpost, without that the numbers did not add up.

posts.title: New shelter requirement for recruits
posts.text: We are raising the minimum from level 20 to level 25. Recruits already inside keep their seat, nothing changes for them.

posts.title: Non aggression pact with [KRN] and [S7]
posts.text: Agreed until the end of the season. Do not attack their bases or their gatherers, even unshielded. Any incident, tell an officer before you react.

join.title: 3 seats open
join.text: Join the Discord, introduce yourself in the applications channel, and tell us your in game name, your shelter level, and when you usually play. An officer answers the same day.
